assumptions.label: estimate

issues.description: The traction pad is specified as a part but is absent from the BOM, so the factory cannot procure or install it.
issues.fix: Add the EVA pad and its adhesive or specified self-adhesive backing to the BOM; define its placement.
issues.rule_citation: BOM must include every assembled component — IPC-2571 product data exchange standard.

issues.description: The laminate specification omits cloth weight, layer count, layup locations, and resin cure requirements. Strength, weight, and repeatability cannot be controlled.
issues.fix: Provide a laminate schedule, target finished weight, and the resin supplier’s mixing and cure instructions.
issues.rule_citation: Follow specified resin mixing and cure conditions — polyester resin supplier technical data sheet.

issues.description: Fin box and leash plug models, routed cavities, and installation method are unspecified; fit and watertightness cannot be verified.
issues.fix: Specify compatible box, fin, and plug models, routing templates, installation resin, and a watertightness inspection.
issues.rule_citation: Define mating-part geometry and assembly requirements on production drawings — ASME Y14.5.

issues.description: Solid product (60.2 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: hand / CNC shaping of a foam blank + hand lamination.
issues.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
issues.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Solid volume of all parts, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Board length 2286 mm (7.5 ft) fits standard PU blank stock (up to 9'0" / 2745 mm).
issues.fix: Order the next blank size up with the right rocker; keep 20-30 mm shaping allowance.
issues.rule_citation: Blank sizes of the major foam suppliers (6'0" to 9'0" shortboard/mid-length ranges) — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Overall length, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Maximum hull thickness 72 mm (with rocker the bbox is taller): enough float for the brief.
issues.fix: Keep ≥ 65 mm at the centre for beginners; move volume under the chest, not into the rails.
issues.rule_citation: Surf shaping rule of thumb: beginner mid-lengths 65-80 mm thick — Estimate

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Smallest extent of the hull, measured on the product CAD (build123d/OCCT)

issues.description: Gloss polish is not an applicable finish for a textured EVA traction pad and conflicts with its intended grip.
issues.fix: Specify the pad texture, color, and adhesive backing; remove the gloss-polish requirement.
issues.rule_citation: Specify surface texture appropriate to functional requirements — ISO 1302 surface texture indication.

certifications.applies_because: The surfboard is imported from China for US sale, so it generally must be marked with its country of origin in a conspicuous, legible, and sufficiently permanent manner.

issues.description: Solid product (60.2 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: hand / CNC shaping of a foam blank + hand lamination.

issues.description: Board length 2286 mm (7.5 ft) fits standard PU blank stock (up to 9'0" / 2745 mm).
issues.fix: Order the next blank size up with the right rocker; keep 20-30 mm shaping allowance.
issues.rule_citation: Blank sizes of the major foam suppliers (6'0" to 9'0" shortboard/mid-length ranges) — Estimate

issues.description: Maximum hull thickness 72 mm (with rocker the bbox is taller): enough float for the brief.
issues.fix: Keep ≥ 65 mm at the centre for beginners; move volume under the chest, not into the rails.
issues.rule_citation: Surf shaping rule of thumb: beginner mid-lengths 65-80 mm thick — Estimate

issues.description: The traction pad is specified as a part but is absent from the BOM, and no bonding method is defined.
issues.fix: Add the pad and a marine-grade pressure-sensitive adhesive to the BOM; specify placement and surface preparation.
issues.rule_citation: Define all purchased parts and joining processes in the production BOM and assembly instructions — ISO 10007 configuration management guidelines.

issues.description: The fin boxes and fins have no interface standard or mating specification, so the supplied fins may not fit or lock securely.
issues.fix: Specify a compatible fin-and-box system, drawings or approved suppliers, and an assembly fit check.
issues.rule_citation: Define mating interfaces and verify assembled fit — ISO 8015 GPS fundamentals.

issues.description: Fin box position has a tolerance but no datum, measurement stage, or reference point on the box. Lamination and finishing can also obscure its as-routed position.
issues.fix: Define a centerline and tail datum, specify which box feature is measured, and inspect position on the finished board.
issues.rule_citation: Specify tolerances relative to defined datums and features — ISO 1101 geometrical tolerancing.

issues.description: Gloss polish is not a suitable traction-pad finish; polishing EVA would compromise the intended grip texture.
issues.fix: Specify molded or textured EVA with no polish and define the required surface texture.
issues.rule_citation: Specify finishes compatible with material and functional surface requirements — ISO 9001 design and development requirements.

issues.description: The glass-filled nylon fins have no UV-stabilization requirement despite prolonged outdoor exposure.
issues.fix: Specify a UV-stabilized grade and require supplier evidence of weathering performance.
issues.rule_citation: Assess plastics for outdoor weathering performance — ISO 4892 plastics exposure methods.
